# Interface and Operations Checklist: Journal and Reflect

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for the screens, their states and messages, saving and conflicts, export, accessibility, scale and the change to feature 000's list are complete, clear and consistent before tasks are written.

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), with [plan.md](../plan.md), [screens.md](../screens.md) and [contracts/openapi.yaml](../contracts/openapi.yaml)

## Screens, states and wording

- [x] CHK001 Does every state in the screen inventory (S0 to S5, 25 states) have a stated source of data in the contract, so nothing on a screen has no field behind it? [Traceability, screens.md, contracts/openapi.yaml] → Checked against contracts/openapi.yaml: each of the 25 states has a field (state, tradesChangedAfterReview, focus.yesterday null, previousMonth and nextMonth, calendar marks, validLoss reason, week status); no state lacks a source.
- [x] CHK002 Are the states that were not drawn (today with trades and nothing saved, the retire and rename dialogs for mistakes) given written wording and behaviour, since they were accepted exceptions? [Gap, spec.md Signed-off screens, screens.md] → screens.md section Content added after sign-off gives wording for the Today row, the rename and retire dialogs and the other undrawn states; they are drawn in Penpot at the next session.
- [x] CHK003 Is the wording of each new refusal in the plan present in the wireframe content list or the spec (valid loss "not a loss", a day that has not happened yet, one character over, a stop line above any limit)? [Gap, Spec FR-009, FR-017, data-model.md] → The same section lists every new refusal: not a loss, day not happened yet, one character over, stop line limits.
- [x] CHK004 Is the singular and plural wording of counts ("1 character over", "1 trade changed after you marked this review") stated? [Clarity, screens.md S1, S4] → FR-017 and the addendum give the singular forms (1 character over, 1 trade changed).
- [x] CHK005 Is the account switcher's default (no account given) and whether it is remembered between screens stated, and is the behaviour with no accounts or only archived accounts defined? [Gap, screens.md S0, S1, S5] → FR-028: first active account by name, kept while moving between review screens; no account says Create an account first; archived accounts stay in the switcher.
- [x] CHK006 Is it stated what S1 and S5 show for an account that is archived (reviews of its past days remain readable and editable)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec FR-003] → FR-028: past reviews of an archived account stay readable and editable.
- [x] CHK007 Is the home screen (where `/` leads) and the navigation order (Reviews, Trades, Mistakes, Accounts, Settings) stated, including that the 000 screens keep working unchanged? [Gap, screens.md Navigation] → FR-028: home is Reviews, order and brand stated; the 000 screens work unchanged.
- [x] CHK008 Is the Plan column on the Trades list specified (its values, its wording for not judged yet, where it sits beside the net result), since it changes a signed-off screen of 000? [Gap, plan.md Constitution Check, research.md §11] → FR-027: Plan column values, second line for the label, position beside Net result; wording in the addendum.
- [x] CHK009 Is it stated that the 000 wireframes and `screens.md` are updated in the same change as the Plan column, and the S2 button text corrected, per principle V? [Traceability, Constitution V, plan.md] → plan.md: Penpot gaps (S2 button text, Plan column, addendum wording) are fixed in the same change as the code; recorded in screens.md.

## Saving, leaving and conflicts

- [x] CHK010 Is it stated what happens to typed answers when the owner leaves a daily review without saving (a prompt as in 000, an automatic draft, or loss)? [Gap, Spec FR-006, US1] → Owner decision 2026-10-04 and FR-029: asks first, for the review, the drawer and the focus dialog.
- [x] CHK011 Is it stated whether "Save draft" and "Mark as reviewed" save the grades and the answers together, and whether grades alone can be saved? [Ambiguity, Spec FR-006, FR-010] → FR-006: Save draft and Mark as reviewed both save answers and grades together; grades can be saved alone.
- [x] CHK012 Is the behaviour of the judge drawer defined (explicit Save and Cancel, what Close does with unsaved changes, and that saving does not change the day's reviewed state)? [Gap, screens.md S2, Spec FR-007] → FR-029: the drawer asks before losing changes; saving a judgement does not change a day's reviewed state; the explicit Save and Cancel are the signed-off S2.
- [x] CHK013 Are out-of-date saves (two windows) addressed for a daily review, a judgement, a focus and a mistake, with the same wording style as 000? [Coverage, Gap, 000 FR-022] → FR-029: 409 with the 000 wording for a review, judgement, focus and mistake.
- [x] CHK014 Are loading and failure notices for every write (could not reach the journal, nothing saved, typed text kept) required to match 000's behaviour? [Consistency, 000 FR-023, Spec FR-012] → FR-029: as in 000 (could not reach the journal, nothing saved, text kept).
- [x] CHK015 Is it stated whether undo is offered for clearing a focus, retiring a mistake or marking a week reviewed? [Gap, Spec FR-013, FR-017, FR-021a] → Owner decision 2026-10-04: Undo for clearing a focus and retiring a mistake; none for marking a week reviewed (FR-021a).

## Export, accessibility and scale

- [x] CHK016 Does the export requirement list every kind of record it must contain (mistakes, reviews, focuses, weekly marks, day-level mistakes, judgements) and say where the owner finds it? [Completeness, Spec FR-025, research.md §10, screens.md] → FR-025 lists every kind of record and the one Export button on the Trades screen.
- [x] CHK017 Are keyboard and screen-reader requirements stated for the new controls (the star grade, the judge drawer, the focus dialog, the day and week pickers, collapsible weeks)? [Gap, 000 FR-024, screens.md] → FR-030: stars as a radio group with arrow keys; drawer and dialog focus and Escape; pickers and collapsible weeks keyboard-operable.
- [x] CHK018 Are status words (Missing, Draft, Reviewed, STOP TRADING) and the picker marks (• has trades, ! review missing) required to carry meaning in text, never by colour or shape alone? [Consistency, Constitution I, screens.md, 000 FR-024] → FR-030: status words and picker marks carry meaning in text or symbol; the colour rule of 000 holds.
- [x] CHK019 Is a data size and a response time stated for the new screens, as 000's SC-008 did, since this feature has no performance criterion? [Gap, Spec Success Criteria, plan.md] → New SC-008: 5,000 trades, 10 accounts, a year of reviews, under 1 second for opening, changing month or week, and saving.
- [x] CHK020 Is it stated how SC-001 (five minutes) and SC-005 (8 of 10 days) are measured, given there is no usage tracking? [Measurability, Spec SC-001, SC-005] → SC-001 is a timed browser run on the sample day; SC-005 is read from the Reviews screen's own counts.
- [x] CHK021 Is it stated that existing 000 records and the migrations are safe: the new migrations run in a transaction and change nothing on failure, and the starter mistakes are seeded once? [Coverage, 000 FR-025, data-model.md] → plan.md and data-model.md: migrations are goose files, each in a transaction (000's runner), the starter mistakes are seeded in a migration that runs once.
- [x] CHK022 Is local-only operation (loopback only, no sign-in or audit log, the written exception) restated for every new endpoint and for the export of reviews? [Consistency, Spec FR-022, Constitution IV] → FR-022 covers the whole feature (loopback only, written exception); every endpoint is under it and the export is the existing one.
